_comment: Labelled test set for the confusion matrix. Fraud cases are reconstructions of publicly reported vendor-impersonation patterns (fake-LLC payee as in the Clark County case, bank-change requests, lookalike domains, compromised vendor mailboxes). Legitimate cases are routine traffic from the three seeded vendors plus the two by-design frictions: a first-time vendor and a genuine bank change. The DOJ-derived set is a separate deliverable.
